filtered_sessions.name: filtered_sessions
filtered_sessions.body_sql:
SELECT 
  iap_subject_session.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_id,
  fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_id,
  fclt_rooms.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AS location_id,
  iap_subject_detail.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS subject_id,
  iap_subject_detail.FEE AS fee,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, iap_subject_session.SESSION_START_TIME, iap_subject_session.SESSION_END_TIME) AS duration
FROM iap_subject_session
JOIN fclt_rooms ON iap_subject_session.SESSION_LOCATION = fclt_rooms.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_detail ON iap_subject_session.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iap_subject_detail.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
filtered_sessions.description: sessions restricted to the target period and location type, with duration derived from start and end times

filtered_session_subjects.name: filtered_session_subjects
filtered_session_subjects.description: Session-subject records restricted to a specific session type and academic period.

session_period_metrics.name: session_period_metrics
session_period_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT 
  session,
  COUNT(subject) AS subject_count,
  SUM(fee) AS total_fee,
  MIN(duration) AS min_duration,
  MAX(duration) AS max_duration
FROM filtered_session_subjects
GROUP BY session
session_period_metrics.description: Per-session aggregates calculating subject count, total fees, and duration extremes.

course_base_attributes.name: course_base_attributes
course_base_attributes.body_sql:
SELECT 
    d.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
    d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name,
    c.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
    c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS is_degree_granting
FROM sis_course_description c
JOIN sis_department d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
course_base_attributes.description: denormalized relation linking school, department, and course records to expose school code, school name, department full name, course level, and degree-granting indicator

school_dept_level_aggregates.name: school_dept_level_aggregates
school_dept_level_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT 
  cba.school_code,
  cba.school_name,
  cba.department_full_name,
  cba.course_level,
  COUNT(*) AS total_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cba.is_degree_granting IN ('Y', '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM course_base_attributes cba
GROUP BY cba.school_code, cba.department_full_name, cba.course_level
school_dept_level_aggregates.description: grouped summary of course records by school, department, and level, computing total course count and conditional count for degree-granting courses

dept_aggregated_metrics.name: dept_aggregated_metrics
dept_aggregated_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT 
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_tip_subject_type_count,
    SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,
    MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM tip_subject_offered tso
JOIN tip_detail td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN tip_material tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
dept_aggregated_metrics.description: groups the base cohort by department to compute the count of distinct subject types, total enrollment count, and the minimum and maximum rental prices

course_department_details.name: course_department_details
course_department_details.body_sql:
SELECT 
    scc.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_id,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    scc.SUBJECT_CODE AS sis_subject_code,
    scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS subject_description,
    scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level
FROM sis_subject_code scc
JOIN sis_course_description scd ON scc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE
JOIN sis_department sd ON scc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
course_department_details.description: links each course record to its department, SIS subject code, subject description, and graduate level attributes

status_aggregates.name: status_aggregates
status_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT 
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  COUNT(td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_number_of_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ts.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_number_of_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_number_of_schools,
  MAX(tm.YEAR) AS most_recent_publication_year
FROM `tip_material_status` tms
JOIN `tip_detail` td ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN `tip_subject_offered` ts ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN `tip_material` tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
status_aggregates.description: grouped summary of material details by status, computing counts and maximum publication year

building_address_hr_base.name: building_address_hr_base
building_address_hr_base.body_sql:
SELECT 
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
  CONCAT_WS(' ', ba.STREET_NUMBER, ba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ba.STREET_NAME, ba.STREET_SUFFIX, ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL) AS street_address,
  ba.CITY AS city,
  ba.STATE AS state,
  org.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  bl.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS raw_sqft_value
FROM fclt_building b
JOIN fclt_building_address ba ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fclt_organization org ON b.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN buildings bl ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = bl.BUILDING_KEY
building_address_hr_base.description: joins building, address, and HR department tables to produce a wide relation containing building attributes, address details, HR department name, and the raw square footage values for each record.

term_instructor_metrics.name: term_instructor_metrics
term_instructor_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  `TERM_CODE` AS `term_code`,
  `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS `instructor_id`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `SUBJECT_TITLE`) AS `distinct_subject_types_count`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `COURSE_NUMBER`) AS `distinct_course_types_count`
FROM `subject_offered`
WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`, `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
term_instructor_metrics.description: computes the distinct subject type count per term code and the distinct course type count per instructor across all historical data

fall_term_sections.name: fall_term_sections
fall_term_sections.body_sql:
SELECT 
  SECTION_ID AS section_id,
  SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS instructor_id,
  TERM_CODE AS term_code
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
WHERE TERM_CODE = 'F'
fall_term_sections.description: sections restricted to the fall term based on term code
